bead.title: Register Rapid-MLX provider type
bead.description: Teach config loading and provider registration about type rapid-mlx so configured endpoints such as http://grendel:8000/v1 are accepted as first-class local providers. This is the prerequisite for utilization/performance probing and for DDx execution in environments where grendel-rapid-mlx is present in the local config.
bead.acceptance:
1. Config validation accepts provider type rapid-mlx and rejects malformed Rapid-MLX endpoint config with clear errors.
2. Rapid-MLX endpoints participate in model discovery through the existing OpenAI-compatible surface where applicable.
3. Route-status/list-models can show grendel-rapid-mlx without service startup failure.
4. Tests cover config load, provider registry selection, and a replayed /v1/models response.
5. go test ./internal/config ./internal/provider/... ./internal/serviceimpl -run "RapidMLX|ProviderType|ModelDiscovery" passes.
